title: A munkatársam, a főnököm: Possessive Suffixes at Work

sections.title: New nouns, the same suffixes
sections.content: munkatárs ("colleague, coworker") and főnök ("boss") work exactly like every other noun you've already put a possessive suffix on: a munkatársam ("my colleague"), a munkatársad ("your colleague"), a főnököm ("my boss"), a főnököd ("your boss"). Nothing new about the endings — just two useful new workplace nouns to attach them to.

items.english: Petra is my colleague, she's very helpful.

items.spanish: A főnököm tapasztalt, és a csapatom nagyon jó.
items.english: My boss is experienced, and my team is very good.

sections.content: csapat ("team") takes the same suffixes too: a csapatom ("my team"). Keep stacking new workplace nouns onto the possessive pattern you already own.
